description: The file is a Markdown tutorial document explaining how to work with SQL databases using FastAPI and SQLModel in Python. It includes code snippets, instructions, and explanations for creating models, setting up database engines, and building RESTful API endpoints.

classes.name: Hero
classes.description: A SQLModel class representing a hero, with a primary key 'id', a 'name', 'age', and 'secret_name'. It maps to a database table.

classes.name: HeroBase
classes.description: A base class for hero data, containing shared fields 'name' and 'age'. Used as a parent class for other models.

classes.name: HeroPublic
classes.description: A data model representing the hero's data exposed to clients, including 'id', 'name', and 'age'. It excludes sensitive information like 'secret_name'.

classes.name: HeroCreate
classes.description: A data model used for creating new heroes, requiring 'name', 'age', and 'secret_name'. It validates input data from clients.

classes.name: HeroUpdate
classes.description: A data model used for updating heroes, with all fields optional ('name', 'age', 'secret_name'), allowing partial updates.

methods.name: create_tables
methods.description: Initializes database tables based on the models by calling SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine).

methods.name: get_session
methods.description: Creates a FastAPI dependency that yields a SQLModel session for database operations.

methods.name: add_hero
methods.description: Endpoint handler that creates a new hero entry in the database using data from HeroCreate and returns the created hero as HeroPublic.

methods.name: read_heroes
methods.description: Endpoint handler that retrieves a list of heroes from the database, returning a list of HeroPublic instances.

methods.name: read_hero
methods.description: Retrieves a single hero from the database by ID, returning HeroPublic.

methods.name: update_hero
methods.description: Updates an existing hero using data from HeroUpdate; applies only fields that are set.

methods.name: delete_hero
methods.description: Deletes a hero from the database by ID.
